chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me, from a number of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Yahya ibn Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever performs salat (prayer) outside the time, then there is no salat (prayer) for him.

key_terms.صَلَاةَ: salat (prayer), meaning the valid ritual prayer here

ai.seo_question: Is salat (prayer) valid if performed outside its prescribed time?
ai.summary: This hadith states that salat (prayer) performed outside its prescribed time is not valid. It emphasizes the legal importance of observing the appointed prayer times in Islamic worship.
